## EDIT ONE NODE: Runtime Config

**Providers auto-elect on key presence.**

No keys at all -> Ollama + local Whisper.
OPENAI_API_KEY -> GPT.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> Claude.
DEEPGRAM_API_KEY -> cloud STT *with*
diarization.

So the template runs for a stranger with
one API key, and runs fully private with
zero keys. Same workflow, same canvas.

If your n8n blocks `$env` in Code nodes,
hardcode values in the CFG object.

## STT split

Only place the graph forks on provider,
because cloud STT needs the audio *bytes*
and the local service takes a *path*.

Cloud = Deepgram. Mono audio is diarized
(`diarize=true`); dual-channel audio is
transcribed per channel
(`multichannel=true`), left = REP,
right = PROSPECT.

No DEEPGRAM_API_KEY -> local service.

## Everything below is provider-blind

`Normalize Transcript` and `Normalize LLM
Response` flatten every vendor's shape into
one contract. Chunking, reduction, gating
and CRM mapping never learn which provider
ran.

That is what makes this swappable rather
than three workflows pretending to be one.

## Confidence gate

Score is discounted by chunk parse-success
rate, so silent JSON failures drag it down
instead of hiding inside an average.

Below MIN_CONFIDENCE (default 0.6) routes
to human review. Never let unreviewed model
output write to a live CRM - that is how
these projects lose trust permanently.

## CRM-agnostic

Canonical record -> adapter -> provider.

Default `webhook` POSTs the canonical JSON
anywhere: works with ANY CRM, including ones
not implemented, and needs no credentials -
point it at webhook.site to demo.

zoho | hubspot | salesforce | pipedrive are
built in. Adding one is a new `case` in
Build CRM Request. Nothing upstream moves.

Zoho: set CRM_BASE_URL for your region
(.com / .eu / .in / .com.au).

## monday.com

monday has **no standard fields** - a board is
whatever columns the customer made. You cannot
hardcode a mapping, so we introspect the board
and match canonical fields to real column ids.

`mapping_report.unmapped` is the money:
fields the AI extracted that the board has
nowhere to store. That list IS a consulting
finding - hand it to them.

Set MONDAY_BOARD_ID + CRM_TOKEN.
Other CRMs skip these three nodes.
